title: A mechanism-based approach to the prevention of chronic pain and its comorbid mental disorders
summary: The MechPain project aims at preventing the chronification of pain with associated mental disorders in patients with a diagnosis of musculoskeletal pain, neuropathic pain, or headache in the subacute phase. The project consists of 5 Workpackages. The analysis of published data will help identifying the most relevant factors of pain development. These factors will be used to develop a personalized digital training program aimed at contrasting the transition from the subacute to the chronic pain phase. The personalized digital training program will constitute a preventive approach to the treatment of pain chronification. This digital intervention will be controlled and tested to measure its preventive effect. The results might pave the way to new and innovative treatment approaches to pain.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Presence of group membership (primary musculoskeletal pain, or neuropathic pain, or primary headache in the subacute stage, i.e. less than 3 months since the onset of symptoms)
- Sufficient eyesight for mobile phone use (possibly with visual aid)
- Age limit - at least 18 years old
- Sufficient legal capacity to sign a declaration of consent
- Sufficient proficiency of the German language
Exclusion criteria:
- Persons with current primary mental disorder that needs treatment
- Persons with secondary pain
- Contra-indications to Magnetic Resonance Imaging
- Pregnancy
- Persons unable to consent
- Persons with inadequate or unclear treatment of the underlying disease, current application for reduced earning capacity pension, ongoing psychotherapy and severe physical or psychiatric comorbidity
